thread:
alex: Heads-up — quick proposal for a 'filterflow' feature: tie per-model snapshots to route views so when you pin a model snapshot the console filters and previews automatically use that model version. Thoughts?
maria: Sounds useful. How does this interact with our saved-query ownership model? Today saved queries are model-agnostic for most teams.
alex: Idea: saved queries get an optional 'modelBinding' field. UI shows a small badge when set: "pinned to model vX". Backend-wise we add modelBinding to the SavedQuery proto; migration is no-op if absent.
sam: Proto change is fine but routing policy needs to respect it. If a saved query requests a pinned model we should try that model first, then fallback to default/cheaper variants if capacity or quota prevents it.
emily: We already have fallback policies for routes. Suggest reuse: routePriority = [pinnedModel, defaultModel, costOptimizedModel]. Also we need to surface cost — pinning to a larger model could double per-token cost, show that in the save dialog. :money_with_wings: 
alex: UX sketch: when saving a query with modelBinding, show expected token-cost delta and a 'Require pinned model' toggle (default off). If off, fallback allowed.
maria: @alex can you paste a minimal API payload so I can wire up the front-end mock?
alex: Sure — minimal example:
```
POST /api/saved_queries
{
  "name":"perf-run-2026-03",
  "filter":"status:success AND latency>50",
  "modelBinding":{"model":"redwood/xl-quant-v2","requirePinned":false}
}
```
sam: Telemetry implication: we must tag route events with saved_query_id and modelBinding when present. Also bump sampling for model-bound queries by +0.1 so regressions surface faster.
emily: Rollouts concern: changing the modelBinding org-wide is a risky change. We should support saved-query-scoped rollouts (canary) — e.g., apply to 5% of traffic, measure cost and quality deltas per query. Console should expose a small rollout panel for each saved query.
alex: Agree. Ops considerations: migration path for existing saved queries -> modelBinding null. We'll add an endpoint /api/saved_queries/rollout to control canary groups and percentage.
maria: :thumbsup: Who owns the epic? I can take UI flows if @alex handles API + proto changes and @sam covers routing/quota enforcement.
alex: I'll write an RFC + proto patch and open an initial PR for the API. Targeting the week of 2026-04-06 for staging. Tagging milestone: saved-query-modelbinding-v1.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: SavedQuery service v2 deployed to staging (sha: c3f2a1).
sam: Quick perf note from staging run: modelBinding lookup adds ~0.6ms in the hot path (KV lookup + policy eval) — within SLO but we should keep an eye when batching at scale.
emily: I'll add a row to the console mockup showing cost delta and a little tooltip explaining fallback semantics.
alex: Cool. Next steps: RFC + proto, UI mocks, routing + telemetry work items. Meeting to sync on Monday?
